correctedCritiques.pro-first-cause-01: Strongest feature: The conditional architecture is exceptionally recoverable, distinguishing infinite causal regression, circular causation, and termination, while expressly limiting its conclusion to the existence of at least one first cause. Principal limitation: The presentation explicitly postpones the substantive demonstrations excluding both rival structures, leaving its evidential support promissory rather than independently established within this constructive passage. Live burden: The argument therefore still requires nonstipulative defenses of causal transitivity, the impossibility of a closed causal loop, and the exclusion of an infinite regress before its announced conditional can establish an actual terminus. Locked score: The strong/competent band appropriately reflects excellent structural relevance, disciplined qualification, and coherent inferential organization, alongside materially incomplete warrant for the indispensable antecedent exclusions.
